acceptance_predicates.description: The AR-1689 receipt parses as one valid JSON document and ends with a real newline.
The repaired receipt digest is recomputed and accepted through handoffctl.
Independent review confirms exact heads, privacy and the repaired digest.
Generated projections and post-repair state are consistent.

definition_of_done: The malformed byte is repaired without changing reviewed qualification content.
Independent review and exact-head verification pass.

inputs.description: The existing paired ASB/TUI qualification receipt.

outputs.description: A valid newline-terminated receipt with accepted digest.

gates.description: Receipt bytes are valid JSON with a real trailing newline.
The repaired digest and independent review are recorded durably.
